facts.fact: Prabhudas Lilladher Q2FY27 update: BUY, target raised to Rs10,500 (25x Sep-28E EV/EBITDA for hospitals and offline pharmacy, 20x AHLL); digital reached cash breakeven in Q2FY27; established hospital margin 25.8%; management cut the FY27 exit EBITDA guidance for the integrated HealthCo/NewCo business to Rs1,500 cr from Rs1,650-1,750 cr.

Q2FY27 results (Screener): revenue Rs7,615 cr, EBITDA Rs1,191 cr, attributable PAT Rs630 cr. Screener restated the Jun-2026 and Sep-2025 quarters (revenue Rs6,932 cr and Rs6,189 cr), apparently presenting Apollo Cradle and Fertility separately.
